# IsCountableCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.4" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `IsCountableCanBeUsedInspection`

`is_array($v) || $v instanceof Countable` is exactly what `is_countable($v)`
checks. On a language level where `is_countable()` is available, the one call
is shorter and makes the intent obvious.

## Example

```php{3,4,5}
<?php
function sizeOf($bag, $other) {
    $a = is_array($bag) || $bag instanceof \Countable;
    $b = ($bag instanceof Countable) || is_array($bag->items) || $bag->items instanceof Countable;
    $c = $other === null || (is_array($other) || ($other instanceof \Countable));

    $d = is_array($bag) || $other instanceof Countable;           // different subject
    $e = (is_array($bag)) || $bag instanceof Countable;           // call is parenthesised
    $f = is_array($bag) || $bag instanceof Traversable;           // other interface
    $g = is_array($bag) || ($bag instanceof Countable && $other); // inside &&
    $h = is_array($bag) or $bag instanceof Countable;             // keyword or
    $i = is_array($bag) && $x || $bag instanceof Countable;       // direct parent is &&
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Use &#39;is_countable($bag)&#39; instead of the is_array()/instanceof Countable pair.</li>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;is_countable($bag-&gt;items)&#39; instead of the is_array()/instanceof Countable pair.</li>
<li>line 5: Use &#39;is_countable($other)&#39; instead of the is_array()/instanceof Countable pair.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "IsCountableCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore IsCountableCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection IsCountableCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
